run_shell_builder: run shell_builder.py to generate a bash build script from fbcode_builder_config.py
build_with_shellfbcodebuilder: build a ShellFBCodeBuilder instance to render shell commands for host-based builds
render_build_steps: render build steps into a bash script using ShellFBCodeBuilder render method
find_project_root: find the git project root directory from the shell_builder.py location
create_persistent_temp_dir: create a persistent temporary directory path for fbcode_builder cache and artifacts
